provenance.equation: Driven Hodgkin-Huxley repetitive spiking (five upward v>=0 crossings over 60 one-millisecond macro steps) advanced with the exact macro-step integrator: 100 inner four-stage classical RK4 sub-steps of dt=0.01 per macro step, rising-edge crossing evaluated only on the macro boundary, no reset. This matches HodgkinHuxleyNeuron(integrator='rk4'), whose step() is itself a 100-sub-step macro step over the same simultaneous RK4. The four-state membrane and Na/K gating rate functions (numpy exp rates and the exprel-rewritten alpha_m/alpha_n) are independently re-derived from the Hodgkin-Huxley (1952) model definition, matching the schema runner bit-for-bit.
